<script>
  (function() {
    const sheetID = "1ZgcJc8n-pC4crM3zqq4LPUJ9hTGbmhgpfV6XI87wr5A";
    const gid = "0"; 
    const finalUrl = `https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/${sheetID}/gviz/tq?tqx=out:csv&gid=${gid}`;

    function startApp() {
      const container = document.getElementById('assetChart');
      if (typeof Plotly === 'undefined') { setTimeout(startApp, 200); return; }

      fetch(finalUrl)
        .then(res => res.text())
        .then(csvText => {
          container.innerHTML = "";
          
          const rows = csvText.split(/\r?\n/).filter(line => line.trim() !== "");
          const labels = [];
          const values = [];

          for (let i = 1; i < rows.length; i++) {
            const cols = rows[i].split(/,(?=(?:(?:[^"]*"){2})*[^"]*$)/);
            if (cols.length >= 9) {
              const ticker = cols[0].replace(/"/g, '').trim();
              const weightStr = cols[8].replace(/"/g, '').replace('%', '').trim();
              const weight = parseFloat(weightStr);
              if (!isNaN(weight) && weight > 0) {
                labels.push(ticker);
                values.push(weight);
              }
            }
          }

          Plotly.newPlot('assetChart', [{
            values: values, labels: labels, type: 'pie', hole: 0.6,
            marker: { colors: ["#007AFF", "#5AC8FA", "#4CD964", "#FFCC00", "#FF9500", "#FF2D55", "#5856D6"] },
            textinfo: 'label+percent',
            textfont: { family: 'SF Pro Text', size: 12 }
          }], {
            showlegend: true,
            legend: { 
              orientation: 'h',
              x: 0.5, xanchor: 'center',
              y: -0.05, yanchor: 'top',
              font: { family: 'SF Pro Text', size: 11 } 
            },
            paper_bgcolor: 'rgba(0,0,0,0)',
            plot_bgcolor: 'rgba(0,0,0,0)',
            margin: { t: 20, b: 60, l: 10, r: 10 } 
          }, {responsive: true, displayModeBar: false});
        });
    }
    window.addEventListener('load', startApp);
    startApp();
  })();
</script>
